honest_verdict: complete: kv260 yosys synthesis succeeds with 0 errors, 18 warnings (all benign memory->register replacements). The fix already shipped in commit 3723c8912 added carnot_ising_top.v wrapper + xilinx_unisim_stubs.v LUT6 stub; this run verifies the fix.
file_with_error: (historical, now resolved) Missing top-level wrapper module and missing UNISIM LUT6 primitive stubs. The kanele_lut.v / kan_lut_block.v / kanele_top.v chain instantiated the Xilinx UNISIM cell `LUT6` by name, which is built-in inside Vivado but undefined under open-source yosys. Without a top-level wrapper, yosys also lacked a single hierarchy root to prune the conflicting duplicate definitions of `ising_sampler_128_sync` (defined in ising_sampler_v2.v:71, ising_sampler_v2_synth.v:71, and minimal_axi_responder.v:38).
error_description: exp2427 (.235) saw synthesis_errors=1 because yosys could not resolve `LUT6` (a Xilinx UNISIM primitive not present in the open-source library) and had no top module to drive the hierarchy pass. The fix landed in commit 3723c8912fdb10d90ce2bf4700f180391e8bb94a (2026-05-18 22:02 EDT) as part of an interrupted-run checkpoint: hardware/kv260/carnot_ising_top.v (a wrapper that wires axi_resp + ising_sampler_n16 + symbolic_kan + discrete_sb_256 + kanele_top behind a single 7-port boundary) and hardware/kv260/xilinx_unisim_stubs.v (a behavioral LUT6 stub: a 64-entry 1-bit ROM addressed by the six inputs with INIT-supplied contents; bit-identical to UNISIM LUT6 for legal inputs). With the wrapper as top, yosys's hierarchy pass prunes the redundant duplicate module bodies and synthesis completes cleanly. This run is a verification pass, not a fresh diagnose/fix cycle.
warning_note: All 18 yosys warnings are 'Replacing memory \<name> with list of registers'. This is the expected yosys behaviour when an array is written in a parallel/non-RAM access pattern; the memory is correctly mapped to discrete registers by the synth pass. No warning indicates a real RTL bug.
fix_iterations_note: 0 because the underlying fix already landed in commit 3723c8912 (2026-05-18). This experiment is the verification pass: yosys was run once on the current tree and reported 0 errors. The prior exp2427 (.235) failure cause is now diagnosed and documented.

Step 2: grep -ciE 'error' /tmp/yosys_output.txt -> 0 errors. grep -ciE 'warning' -> 19 lines (18 benign memory->register + 1 'Warnings:' summary).

Step 3: No fix required. Compared 20 current .v files to the 18 listed in exp2427 — the additions are carnot_ising_top.v (wrapper) and xilinx_unisim_stubs.v (LUT6 stub). git log identified commit 3723c8912 as the source.
Step 4: Confirmed CHECK pass 'Found and reported 0 problems' and synth_statistics show a clean 523-cell mapping.
Step 5: Wrote this artifact and a verification test.
